caption: Press New in the Apollo to do view: the new note gets the Task template, the view's filter values and a name from the pattern.
eval: (async () => { const kept = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); for (const leaf of [...app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown'), ...app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('bases')]) if (leaf !== kept) leaf.detach(); app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(kept, { focus: true });  const P = 'Bases Note Templates'; const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-note-templates']; for (const f of app.vault.getMarkdownFiles().filter((f) => f.path.startsWith(P + '/Tasks/') && /^(\d{4}-|Untitled)/.test(f.basename))) await app.vault.delete(f); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach((m) => { m.querySelector('.modal-close-button')?.click(); m.remove(); }); p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.bases = { [P + '/Tasks.base']: { templates: [P + '/Templates/Task.md'], folder: '', pattern: '{{date}} {{project}}', onNew: true, views: {} } }; await p.saveSettings(); p.refreshButtons(); const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const st = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...st, state: { ...st.state, viewName: 'Apollo to do' } }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const c = document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-toolbar-new-item-menu'); (c.querySelector('.text-icon-button, button') || c.firstElementChild).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1800)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach((m) => { m.querySelector('.modal-close-button')?.click(); m.remove(); }); document.body.click(); const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-note-templates']; p.pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()

eval: (async () => { const P = 'Bases Note Templates'; const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-note-templates']; for (const f of app.vault.getMarkdownFiles().filter((f) => f.path.startsWith(P + '/Tasks/') && /^(\d{4}-|Untitled)/.test(f.basename))) await app.vault.delete(f); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach((m) => { m.querySelector('.modal-close-button')?.click(); m.remove(); }); p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.bases = { [P + '/Tasks.base']: { templates: [P + '/Templates/会議 🧪.md'], folder: '', pattern: '{{date}} Café 🧪', onNew: true, views: {} } }; await p.saveSettings(); p.refreshButtons(); const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const st = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...st, state: { ...st.state, viewName: 'Apollo to do' } }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const button = document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-toolbar-new-item-menu'); (button.querySelector('.text-icon-button, button') || button.firstElementChild).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1800)); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach((m) => m.querySelector('.modal-close-button')?.click()); const created = app.vault.getMarkdownFiles().filter((f) => f.path.startsWith(P + '/Tasks/') && f.basename.includes('Café 🧪')).sort((a, b) => b.stat.ctime - a.stat.ctime)[0]; if (!created) throw new Error('The nested template note was not created'); await app.workspace.getLeaf('tab').openFile(created, { active: true }); const current = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const state = current.getViewState(); await current.setViewState({ ...state, state: { ...state.state, mode: 'source', source: true } }); return 'ok'; })()
